verdicts.reason: Both use the same banner reflow: the headline is oversized and leaves 'fizz' alone on its own line, the subcopy is a cramped 3-line block wedged in beside the CTA, and the bottle is shrunk below the headline's weight. A also stacks both circles in the left column, so the SOLSTICE wordmark sits awkwardly across the edges of both circles and the left side looks cluttered. B keeps the original's opposite-corner circle placement, with the green circle behind the headline as a flat, deliberate layer, so it is marginally more faithful and balanced.
